e10_1_revalidation.summary: E10.1 claims revalidated from physical evidence files. AC-14 (global store lifecycle) remains PARTIAL.

mission_timeout.details: Mission-level timeout implemented in OperationalExecutionEngine.execute_mission() via asyncio.wait_for. 2s timeout on 10s sleep task correctly triggers TIMEOUT at ~2027ms. Resources released via complete_mission(). No false COMPLETED state.

resource_idempotency.details: complete_mission() is idempotent - uses max(0, counter-1) pattern. Multiple duplicate calls never produce negative counters. Task counts cleaned up on mission completion.

resource_accounting.details: Quota enforcement under concurrent contention verified: 3/5 missions created (quota=3), 10/15 tasks created (quota=10). Rejected requests receive ResourceQuotaExceededError. Release via complete_mission() allows new allocations. Counters never negative.

evidence_lifecycle.details: Cross-engine isolation VERIFIED (separate stores). Reference integrity VERIFIED (artifacts match global store). Purge policy NOT_IMPLEMENTED (accumulates indefinitely). Deletion of referenced artifact NOT_IMPLEMENTED (no reference counting).

regression.details: All 91 tests pass (43 unified + 48 contracts). No regressions introduced.

open_gaps.impact: Accumulates indefinitely across runs in single engine instance. No reference counting to prevent deletion of referenced artifacts.
open_gaps.decision: DEFERRED - requires ADR for retention policy

open_gaps.impact: No programmatic way to cancel a running mission. Mission timeout provides time-based termination but not user-initiated cancellation.
open_gaps.decision: DEFERRED - E11 Human Mission Control scope

e10_2_verdict.e11_blockers: None - mission timeout, resource idempotency, concurrent quota enforcement, and cross-engine isolation are all VERIFIED. Deferred gaps (purge policy, cancellation API) do not block E11 which builds operational interface on top of verified runtime.
